source: Claude Code CLI 2.1.322 stream-json with --replay-user-messages. Stop the CLI while a background Bash sleep remains, then immediately send a new user uuid to --resume. The CLI emits a stopped task notification and a textless success for that notification before echoing the new uuid and answering it. Only the SDK frames and fields the delivery test reads are retained.

stopped_task.summary: Background shell command didn't finish before the previous session ended

new_input.content: Do not use tools. Reply with exactly REPLAY PROBE.
